jev_distillation.evidence: Training data lists "community typed-decision sets" without naming them. Footer: "it was not trained on Jev outputs." The Jev API appears only as a benchmark row ("Jev 1.13.0 (TypeSafe AI, API) | closed").

installer_policy.reason: The model licence (cc-by-nc-4.0) allows non-commercial use only. The author has not published where the training data came from. We found no statement or evidence that it was distilled from Jev outputs.

readout.notes: llm2jev reads option-label logits from vLLM or SGLang token logprobs; vLLM needs --max-logprobs 256 and --return-tokens-as-token-ids. Not plain OpenAI completions; llama.cpp and MLX not verified.
readout.portable_notes: Author llm2jev --backend hf uses plain transformers; CPU fallback is available with CUDA hidden and device_map auto. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tic-top/llm2jev/1b2521c73cde94129a7cc9c2e48a2ac329572073/llm2jev/backends.py L147: def __init__(self, model, device=None, dtype="bfloat16", **_):; L158: self.model = cls.from_pretrained(model, dtype=getattr(torch, dtype), device_map=device or "auto").eval(). CLI __main__.py L79 instantiates that backend without a device override. BF16 CPU variant added, unmeasured. No explicit MPS selection or author Mac recipe at the pinned revision, so no MPS variant added. HF is a serial correctness reference, not the GPU serving benchmark. vLLM logprob_token_ids and SGLang token_ids_logprob mean backend_agnostic=false for the network shims. Noncommercial restriction retained.

serve.recipe_source: author README (raw/jpt-4b/README.md @277ae37b); llm2jev v0.6.1 vendored at intake vendor/jpt_llm2jev
steps: vllm serve kirp/jpt-4b --max-logprobs 256 --return-tokens-as-token-ids --enable-scale-out --port 8000  (the three flags are required)
No-GPU check only: llm2jev --model kirp/jpt-4b --backend hf --port 8080 (serialises requests)

variants.expected_speed: About 0.18 s raw p 50 per decision on the BH measurement box (0.50 s adjusted). Provisioning class: RTX 4090 24 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: Weights 9.1 GB BF16; min 12 / recommended 16 GB (ROSTER estimate ~11 GB). The card's assets/*.gif are excluded. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 9.079 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 16 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more.

steps: Install pinned llm2jev with CPU torch, transformers and accelerate.
POST /v1/systemone; author HF backend serializes requests and reads full-vocabulary logits in-process.

variants.expected_speed: Estimate only: roughly 100–300 prefill tokens/s on a recent 16-core CPU for a 4B model, so 300–1500 tokens take about 1–15 s per forward pass. No CPU benchmark or probability parity check.

CLI __main__.py L79 instantiates that backend without a device override. BF16 CPU variant added, unmeasured.
